desc: Shows display filter byte-code, for debugging dfilter routines.
r: dftest - Shows display filter byte-code, for debugging dfilter routines.
dftest is a simple tool which compiles a display filter and shows its bytecode.
<dl><dt>filter</dt><dd>The display filter expression. If needed it has to be quoted.</dd></dl>

Show how the IP protocol is filtered:

    dftest ip

Shows how frame 150 is filtered:

    dftest "frame.number == 150"
